scientific_question: Does the fixed full-normal correction preconditioned by the diagonal of the signed-sketch Hessian, which retrospectively passed all 104 v194 development cells, remain strict-safe over the complete 101-frame p=22kw_size=01 trajectory, and does it retain any headroom after cheaper signed-seed and fit-mean controls plus the equal-exact-call full-DCT control are evaluated under the same physical replay?

fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, process, reproduction, rank, stationarity, noninterference, permutation, replay, call, completeness, finite, source or independent-comparison failure makes v195 inconclusive.

If diagonal_normal_step1_k1 fails any strict cell or any complete calibration-sensor tail, conclude FAIL_DIAGONAL_SIGNED_SKETCH_COMPLETE_TRAJECTORY_V195 and close this fixed diagonal correction; controls remain diagnostic and cannot rescue it.
If the diagonal primary passes and fit_mean_k1 also passes the complete gate, conclude PASS_FIT_MEAN_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V195 and prefer the cheaper fixed prior; do not advance the diagonal mechanism.

If the diagonal primary passes, fit_mean_k1 fails, and signed_seed_k1 passes, conclude PASS_SIGNED_SEED_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V195 and prefer the correction-free sketch; do not advance the diagonal mechanism.

If the diagonal primary passes, both cheaper controls fail, and full_dct_k1 passes, conclude PASS_FULL_DCT_EQUAL_CALL_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V195; the diagonal mechanism has no established complete-trajectory advantage.

Only if diagonal_normal_step1_k1 passes all 2626 cells and 26 complete groups while fit_mean_k1, signed_seed_k1 and full_dct_k1 each fail may v195 conclude PASS_DIAGONAL_SIGNED_SKETCH_COMPLETE_TRAJECTORY_HEADROOM_V195 and authorize one separately frozen p14 validation gate.
No v195 outcome is a deployable algorithm, exact-call reduction, resource result, external generalization, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success or algorithm breakthrough.
